name: Panel glass grafito · vertical · cuadratico · radio 4

-- RCC | Panel glass grafito · vertical · cuadratico · radio 4

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 340)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 42)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22

local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel

  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 260, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 340) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / grafito / cuadratico"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

name: Panel glass vino · vertical · cuadratico · radio 8
description: Variante configurable de la receta de panel RCC: distribución vertical de 260 × 340, paleta vino RGB(63, 34, 48), transición Quad de 0.3s y esquinas de 8px. Crea una interfaz adaptable y un botón que alterna la transparencia; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Panel glass vino · vertical · cuadratico · radio 8
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propio juego.
-- Variante configurable: misma receta de interfaz; cambia tamaño, color y transición.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 340)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(63, 34, 48)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 260, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 340) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / vino / cuadratico"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")

border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)

border.Parent = panel

label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / vino / retroceso"

  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})

name: Panel glass hielo · vertical · suave · radio 12
description: Variante configurable de la receta de panel RCC: distribución vertical de 260 × 340, paleta hielo RGB(75, 98, 116), transición Sine de 0.25s y esquinas de 12px. Crea una interfaz adaptable y un botón que alterna la transparencia; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Panel glass hielo · vertical · suave · radio 12
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propio juego.
-- Variante configurable: misma receta de interfaz; cambia tamaño, color y transición.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 340)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 98, 116)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 260, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 340) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / hielo / suave"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)

name: Panel glass grafito · cuadrado · rebote · radio 12
description: Variante configurable de la receta de panel RCC: distribución cuadrado de 320 × 320, paleta grafito RGB(30, 34, 42), transición Bounce de 0.5s y esquinas de 12px. Crea una interfaz adaptable y un botón que alterna la transparencia; no modifica juegos ajenos.
code:
-- RCC | Panel glass grafito · cuadrado · rebote · radio 12
-- LocalScript en StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts de tu propio juego.
-- Variante configurable: misma receta de interfaz; cambia tamaño, color y transición.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("RCCGlassDemo")
if previous then previous:Destroy() end
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RCCGlassDemo"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 320)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 42)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
panel.Parent = gui
local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
scale.Parent = panel
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local function fit()
  if camera then scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera.ViewportSize.X - 32) / 320, (camera.ViewportSize.Y - 32) / 320) end
end
if camera then camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit) end
fit()
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = panel
local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
border.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
border.Transparency = 0.65
border.Parent = panel
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.55, 0)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 12)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = "RCC / grafito / rebote"
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 255)
label.TextWrapped = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 18
label.Parent = panel
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 42)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -58)
button.Text = "Cambiar cristal"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 48)
button.Parent = panel
local active, tween = false, nil
button.Activated:Connect(function()
  active = not active
  if tween then tween:Cancel() end
  tween = TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.65 or 0.22})
  tween:Play()
  button.Text = active and "Restaurar cristal" or "Cambiar cristal"
end)
